prompt.generated_prompt_string: A cinematic mirror selfie of an adult man standing inside a modern stainless-steel elevator. He wears a black motorsport-inspired racing jacket with bold unbranded red panels and geometric patches, light stubble, textured messy dark hair, multiple silver rings, and a thin silver chain necklace. He holds a modern smartphone partly in front of his face while his other hand lightly grips the jacket near the chest. Low moody overhead illumination creates soft highlights on metallic elevator walls and natural shadows on his face. Dark muted blacks, reds, and metallic grays, eye-level mid-torso framing, shallow depth of field, realistic skin texture, and calm introspective luxury-streetwear mood.
